scope: Read-only consolidation of final v2 heldout run and three assistant source reviews; no candidate, fixture, key or review edits and no paid calls.

reviewStandard.percentileMethod: Sorted samples with linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p; timings are warm local runs, not hosted production.

caseIntegrity.answerPayloadHashFormat: SHA256 UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, compact separators; no trailing newline.
caseIntegrity.legacyReviewPayloadHashNote: All 50 exact answerText hashes match the final v2 answers. Part C payload hashes use ASCII-escaped sorted compact JSON and match under that declared alternate format. Part B payload hashes do not match either declared sorted compact format; unresolved serialization/scope mismatch is preserved, not silently repaired. New final-run case and payload hashes are supplied for every case.

exposureNotes: Six v1 answers ran before an independent synthetic source-boundary review stopped v51. No v1 answer content informed v52 tuning. Those first six v2 cases are blind repeats, not first paid executions. The other 44 are first executions.

bySyntheticProjectFacts.provenance: All project fixtures are explicit fictional test scenarios. No proposed attributes of 1070 Southern Boulevard are inferred.

failureStages.normalizationNote: Raw reviewer stages remain per case. Combined interpretation/retrieval failures retain combined categories; no single-stage assignment implies exclusive causation.

decisiveTextCoverage.method: Combined coverage requires source-reviewed actual cited operative text or expressly inspected writer text. Writer-only coverage is unknown where no explicit inspection is recorded. Expected section ID presence does not count. Dependencies and final answer correctness are reviewed separately.

disagreements.aggregationActualTextInspection: Full MC 1006.6 is in the captured writer ENACTED_TEXT. Its diameter and rigid-pipe conditions match the frozen canonical operative paragraph. Original false flags are retained.

dependencyLimitations.note: The frozen same-exception question has a decisive express I-2 exclusion in MC 505.1, but the additional retrieved MC 501.3 conflict was missing MC 102.1 context. Part B records this as an incomplete key/dependency context without invalidating the narrow No conclusion.

runtimeAndCost.environment: Warm local application, end-to-end API run, not hosted production; webSupport=false.
runtimeAndCost.costLimitations: Provider costUSD values are runner estimates from reported usage, not audited account invoices. Preflight query embeddings are separately reported and not attributed as per-turn runtime. Local indexing, prior semantic-index build and prior campaign spend are excluded.

sourceIntegrity.currentCheckoutMismatchNote: The frozen candidate was committed as e194524b2f0b70248bf614d917c4e7f587fa5917 before root applied a separate generic false-boundary correction after this final run. All 136 frozen source files match that committed snapshot. Current app.mjs differs because the working candidate is now being edited; its observation is retained separately from the frozen v2 run. Root confirms final 50 raw answers and source snapshots are unchanged. Subsequent repair diagnostics are excluded from this summary.

frozenCommitAudit.method: SHA256 of exact git show <commit>:permitext-sync-server/<sourcePath> bytes compared to candidate-freeze sourceHashes.

limitations: Disjoint exact primary operative provisions does not establish topic or statistical independence.
Construction chapters, zoning chapters, definitions and applicability parents overlap earlier suites.
Two turns within every scenario share facts/rules and are correlated.
Sources and keys are authored and reviewed by the same assistant; no professional adjudication.
This deliberately selected suite has 25 two-turn correlated scenario families in 14 broader chapter clusters; it does not estimate production population accuracy.
Reviewers are assistants using frozen source keys, actual source text and output packets; no licensed professional adjudication or confidence-bound accuracy claim.
A withheld response may be safer than an erroneous rule, but is still unsuccessful on these source-answerable questions.
The assistant authorship/source review of keys and absence of professional adjudication limit grading independence.
Hosted cold starts, concurrency, authenticated browser continuity, current-source refresh and production accounting remain separate rollout gates.

interpretation: This selected source-reviewed suite delivered 39 of 50 strict passes, 1 minor issue, 7 withheld answers and 3 material errors. The 44 first executions delivered 33 strict passes; 6 blind repeats delivered 6 strict passes. Four directly answerable core conclusions were suppressed after ancillary verification issues. Complete inspected decisive text in 47 cases did not assure correct delivery or interpretation. These are local diagnostic results, not professionally adjudicated product accuracy or release acceptance.
